supplemental_sources.summary: Integrated host review: identity provisioning, current caller guards and owner-only synchronous claim-to-admission remain unchanged. Receiver classifies save/discard/defer using confirmed held replies, deferring unexpected preview failures and candidates whose redundancy depends on unconfirmed replies without saving or ACKing; held IDs still deduplicate. applyReplies retains unexpected-error bodies. Inbox-first maintenance computes T=retained total, M=configured cap, W=retained sources with expires_at>now-REPLY_WINDOW_MS and binary-searches p<=100 using all inbox capacities for 2(max(0,M-T+p)+W) messages (equivalent to 2(F+W+p) for ordinary T<=M, F=M-T) and maximum envelope bytes. No await separates counts/checks and numeric-cap collection; expiry remains independent. Stable full-key overdue pages advance past failed applies and wrap at pass end, scheduling full pages immediately and later passes at next window or within one minute. Source-scoped inbox reads retain correlation and authorization. Close rejects new requests and drains current work before stores close; no normal-shutdown bug or repair is claimed. A saved reply whose apply raises ContractError, RequestMalformedError or ZodError is released as refused; any other apply failure keeps the body for the next cycle. P3a (2026-11-12): the host identity is the only member of a group whose only live binding is the host principal (createBoundGroup, then setGroupAccess and setAccess to the host operations); provisioning rights are inspect, product, enroll, group_create, group_bind, group_member, group_access and access.
